name: DEWALT DW801 850W 100mm (4-Inch) Heavy Duty Angle Grinder
shortDescription: High-torque 850W 100mm angle grinder with epoxy-coated motor windings, jam-pot gear housing, and 11,000 RPM speed for aggressive fabrication cutting and grinding.
overview: The DEWALT DW801 is a legendary industrial workhorse among 100mm (4-inch) angle grinders, trusted by metal fabricators, shipbuilders, and masons for its rugged endurance under intense loads. Powered by an 850-watt champion motor with advanced epoxy resin armature protection, it effectively repels abrasive metal swarf and grinding dust. The cast metal jam-pot gear housing ensures precise gear alignment and superior heat dissipation, while high-grade spiral bevel gears provide smooth, low-vibration operation. Its slim barrel circumference allows comfortable one-handed control during tight pipe deburring and structural weld dressing.
keyFeatures: Robust 850W high-efficiency motor delivering 11,000 RPM no-load speed
Epoxy-coated motor windings protect against abrasive dust abrasion and short circuits
Cast metal gearcase with jam-pot design for precise gear mesh and rigidity
Spiral bevel gears deliver reduced noise, vibration, and increased power transmission
Convenient top-mounted spindle lock button for rapid wheel changeovers
Two-position anti-vibration side handle for balanced left- or right-hand operation
Sealed ball and needle bearings drastically extend operational service life
applications: Heavy weld seam blending and surface preparation
Structural steel profile cutting, notch cutting, and beveling
Concrete tuck-pointing, brick chasing, and tile trimming
Rust stripping, wire brushing, and metal surface descaling
